content: Standard technique for float-to-fixed-point quantization before hashing: multiply by 2^k k chosen so 1 ULP of the fixed-point grid exceeds expected cross-hardware divergence, round-to-nearest, cast to integer, hash the integer bytes. This is a from-scratch algorithmic choice round of x times scale as int32/int64 with no external dependency needed; no widely-adopted OSS library specifically for quantize-before-hash was found; existing libraries target NN quantization compression/accuracy not verification-hashing, so this milestone should implement it directly rather than pull in a quantization framework.
